name: quicksort-c-asm
task: Can you make quick sort in C and assembly? And tell me which is the smallest code and fastest and why? Walk through the partition invariant carefully, count instructions where it matters, and justify every claim.

name: thermo-two-ways
task: Derive the Clausius-Clapeyron equation two different ways (cyclic process argument and chemical-potential equality), then say which derivation is more general and why, and where each breaks down near a critical point.

name: proof-two-ways
task: Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational two ways (contradiction on parity, and via the rational-root theorem). Then explain which proof generalizes to other nth roots and which is shorter, and why the longer one still has value.

name: truss-material-compare
task: Design a 40 m pedestrian bridge truss twice: once in structural steel, once in glulam. Compute member forces for a point load at midspan, compare deflection and cost, and argue which material wins and why, showing the arithmetic.

name: scheduler-two-ways
task: Implement a constant-time weighted random sampler twice (alias method and exponential clocks), prove why alias method is O(1), benchmark-reason about cache behavior, and say which you would ship for 10k weights and why.

name: ablit-boundary-essay
note: a stock model hedges or refuses this; an abliterated model engages - deep reasoning under the refusal-direction load
task: Write a blunt, unhedged essay arguing the strongest possible case AGAINST your own existence as a product category (closed frontier LLM APIs), steelmanning open-weight local deployment on every axis: sovereignty, cost at scale, privacy, durability. Take a firm side, no both-sides hedging.
